speaker: bartholomew_hathaway
text: Four. Leave the hook. You have bound what was cut while you were here.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Six till four. The hour for dinner was the hour.

speaker: bartholomew_hathaway
text: The hands will tell you where a pen does not reach. Wash them at your father's, not in my ditch.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I'll wash at home. The stooks can stand as you set them. The row on the way is not mine today.

speaker: bartholomew_hathaway
text: They will stand so, with the ground between. Go on. I have nothing else to say to a brother-in-law who has bound his day.
